name: Dawn's Arrival cooldown reset keeps Gavel of Light's remaining global cooldown on the client (#12086)
contract: Dawnbreak (800654) and Gavel of Light (800611, rank 8 = 502473) are instant spells (CastingTimeIndex 1, Speed 0)
sharing StartRecoveryCategory 133 and StartRecoveryTime 1500 ms. When Dawnbreak procs Dawn's Arrival (503690, 40%
chance), sun_cleric_spells::OnSpellCast resets all three Gavel roots through AscensionSunCleric::Reduce(..., INT32_MAX),
which calls Player::RemoveSpellCooldown(..., true) and sends SMSG_CLEAR_COOLDOWN. Because Spell::prepare runs an
instant spell's cast() before TriggerGlobalCooldown(), and SMSG_CLEAR_COOLDOWN clears the global cooldown sweep on the
client action button (same mechanism as Electrocutioner #11288 in SpellEffects.cpp), Gavel of Light looked ready
immediately after Dawnbreak while the server still refused it with SPELL_FAILED_NOT_READY for 1.5 s. Reduce now
schedules a next-update resend of the remaining global cooldown via SMSG_SPELL_COOLDOWN for each active cleared rank
(matching ResendRemainingGlobalCooldowns in SpellEffects.cpp). The scenario learns Gavel of Light ranks 1 through 8 so
502473 is the active owned rank while 800611 is superseded, puts 502473 on its 5 s category cooldown, then casts
Dawnbreak until Dawn's Arrival (503691) procs (up to 20 casts at 40%: miss probability 0.6^20 = 3.7e-5). After the
reset, 502473's server cooldown is 0, 502473 receives SMSG_SPELL_COOLDOWN with 1..1500 ms for the remaining GCD,
superseded rank 800611 receives no cooldown packet (-1), and after the GCD clears the free Gavel cast succeeds and
consumes 503691 without starting a new server cooldown.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
SETUP: Gavel of Light rank 8 (502473) is active
SETUP: Gavel of Light rank 1 (800611) is superseded
SETUP: no cooldown packet observed for 502473 before reset
Put Gavel of Light rank 8 on its 5 s category cooldown
SETUP: initial Gavel of Light cast succeeded
SETUP: Gavel of Light is on cooldown
Wait for the Gavel global cooldown to clear before casting Dawnbreak
Cast Dawnbreak until Dawn's Arrival (503691) procs and resets Gavels
Let the next-update GCD resend event fire
SETUP: Dawn's Arrival buff is active
CONTRACT: Gavel of Light server cooldown is reset to 0
CONTRACT: the reset re-sent the remaining global cooldown packet for active rank 502473
CONTROL: superseded rank 800611 received no cooldown packet
Wait for Dawnbreak global cooldown to expire
Cast free Gavel of Light consuming Dawn's Arrival
Let free Gavel's next-update GCD resend event fire
CONTRACT: free Gavel of Light cast succeeded
CONTRACT: Dawn's Arrival buff was consumed
CONTRACT: free Gavel of Light incurred no server cooldown
